$comment: The docs pages and their order (isoloop/isoloop M4c, decisions 9, 11 and 29; ADR 0006). Lists exactly the pages at the pin (library.lock): the guides in docs/guide (slug = file name) and the generated API pages in docs/api (slug = api/ + file name, page /docs/api/<name>/). A page joins here in the PR that moves the pin to a version that has it. An entry with title, href and description is a link into a page (Kernel config), shown in the sidebar and on /docs/ but not a page. Sections, in order: Start, Build, Agents and tooling, Reference; a section appears once it has a page. leadPending: the guide's lead is still being reshaped to one sentence (M4c task 5), so its description is the lead's first sentence. experimental: the page's feature is @experimental, drawn as the Experimental mark in the sidebar and the pill on /docs/ and the page's title. searchTitle: in <title> and the link preview's title only, where the guide's own title doesn't stand on its own in search results.
